Quebecor Makes $21.96 Billion Bid for Telus in Canadian Telecom Deal

The proposed combination would tie up two of the biggest Canadian telecommunications companies

By

and

Quebecor has proposed a combination with Telus T -3.28 % decrease; down pointing triangle worth 31.31 billion Canadian dollars (US$21.96 billion), potentially tying up two of the biggest Canadian telecommunications companies.

The proposal represents a total consideration of about C$19.45 a share, representing a roughly 60% premium to Telus’s closing share price on the Toronto Stock Exchange on Friday, according to Quebecor.
